description: This source file defines a static helper class CacheHelpers which provides utility methods to generate cache keys for catalog items, brands, and types within the eShopWeb project. It includes predefined cache duration and key templates, facilitating consistent cache key generation across the application.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static class offering cache key generation methods and cache duration configuration for the eShopWeb project's caching mechanism.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string for catalog items based on pagination, brand, and type filters.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string for brand data.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns the cache key string for type data.
